_comment: Apply exclusion gate (src/apply/exclusions.js). Copy this file to apply-exclusions.json (gitignored, personal data) in the same directory and fill in real values. blocked_companies: employer names, ON TOP OF the built-in ['Immunotec','Advisicon'] which can never be removed -- matched by whole-token subset, not substring (see the module doc comment). applied_history: every prior application, one entry per role; title is optional -- an entry with no title matches on company only and produces the applied_company_other_role (needs-human) branch rather than the hard already_applied_history block. Missing or invalid JSON here is a hard error for both the scheduled auto-apply run and the dashboard's one-click Apply; this example file is never read as a fallback.
